repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
    wait until(all(#PresenceSensor).presenceSensor_presence == false)
    triggered = false
}
wait until(all(#PresenceSensor).presenceSensor_presence == true)
all(#ColorControl).colorControl_setColor("purple")
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a periodic `if` to sample the presence condition at the start of every 1-second cycle. The IR requires a rising-edge wait, meaning the action must fire immediately when the sensor transitions from false to true, even if that happens mid-cycle. The candidate fails to observe this transition because it only checks the state at iteration boundaries.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with a blocking `wait until` for the rising edge. This ensures the script suspends until the transition occurs, then executes the action and re-arms for the next transition, matching the IR's `cycle { wait(rising); call }` semantics.
